message: Hey Jane, I hope you're doing well. I was wondering if there's anything special that happened with Timmy today at daycare?
I can't believe Sarah let Timmy go to bed so late last night. It's irresponsible and it's affecting his mood. We need to talk about this.
Good morning, Jane. Please make sure Timmy eats his breakfast. He was a bit fussy this morning.
Thanks for the update, Jane. Timmy really enjoys the time at Little Steps. Keep up the great work!
Jane, I'm running late, can you please stay with Timmy for another 15 minutes? I'll be there asap.
Hi Jane, Timmy had a rough night and didn't sleep well. Just a heads up in case he's grumpy today.
Is there anything Timmy needs for the upcoming daycare event? Happy to help out with supplies or planning.
Jane, I've noticed Timmy's been using some words he shouldn't. Could we make sure to correct him on this?
I'm concerned about Timmy's diet at the daycare. Can we discuss the meal plans sometime next week?
Jane, thank you for the photos from yesterday's activities. Timmy looked so happy!
